faq_section.title: Voice Agent Development — questions and answers
faq_section.subtitle: Practical answers before we discuss your project.

questions.question: Can a voice agent transfer calls to our team?
questions.answer: Yes, when supported by your telephony setup. We agree on transfer conditions, availability and a callback fallback during scoping.

questions.question: Can it use our CRM and calendar?
questions.answer: We assess your APIs and permissions before confirming the integration scope. Appointment rules and duplicate handling are part of the workflow design.

questions.question: How do you evaluate the voice agent?
questions.answer: We test representative calls, interruptions, uncertain answers, tool failures and handoff scenarios before agreeing on a rollout.

questions.question: Can you guarantee that every call is answered correctly?
questions.answer: No. Speech and AI systems have limitations. We define fallback responses, escalation rules and review checkpoints around the actual use case.
